intent: Enforce a maximum task title length of 200 characters as request-level input validation. POST /tasks and PUT /tasks/{id} must reject a title longer than 200 characters with HTTP 400 Bad Request and must not create or modify the task; a title of exactly 200 characters is accepted (POST 201, PUT 200). The existing blank/whitespace title -> 400 behaviour is preserved for both verbs and normal-length titles keep working unchanged. This is a request-validation convenience: no authentication, no persistence-model change, no new endpoints, no new dependencies, no change to the other CRUD endpoints.
